stage: implementation code review before final builds and direct E2E
scope: P6-03 manual same-version build-to-build whole-App upgrade/rollback and Mac native Trash, P6-04 related evidence. No formal signing, notarization, clean-user, macOS14 or Windows acceptance.

findings.finding: Same physical App registered through ancestor aliases could bypass reference/running guards keyed by lexical path.
findings.resolution: Before invoking Trash, aggregate all same canonical App targets and enforce all related running states and reference IDs. Also recognize host paths outside workbench as the logical App package.

findings.finding: Case-sensitive .app/layout detection could fall back to trashing only the signed Resources workbench subtree.
findings.resolution: Resolve native canonical root; identify .app extension without case sensitivity; allow only exact complete workbench layout within an App and refuse other App subtrees.

findings.finding: Expanded outer-App target needed lexical and parent-entry protection for data/home symlink entries which resolve outside the App.
findings.resolution: Guard target against lexical protected paths, native canonical paths, and canonical parent plus final entry before Trash.

findings.finding: Running E2E fixture used own process PID, which migrationPidAlive explicitly excludes.
findings.resolution: Use an actual owned live child and killOwnTree cleanup; no earlier direct execution or real Trash side effect occurred.

findings.finding: New Mac failure codes lacked localized messages and unsupported-platform text still claimed only Windows.
findings.resolution: Added three actionable failure messages in Chinese and English and generalized unsupported-platform text.

findings.finding: New permanent alias unit called nonexistent invalidateConfigCache and did not reach running-guard assertions.
findings.resolution: Use existing mutateConfig write chain; all four focused units pass including both reference and running cases.

clarifications.issue: Initial concern that case alias strings defeat canonical guards
clarifications.result: Retracted after independently establishing fs.promises.realpath and fs.realpathSync.native normalize filesystem casing; pure case alias reference and current-App protection both refuse before helper invocation.

upgradeReview: Manual drill keeps old App and newer data separately, validates staged App and all original distributions, snapshots complete data before forward config normalization, restores snapshot into a fresh data root, and explicitly limits rollback to same product version3.0.1 differing builds. No automatic updater, atomic replacement or arbitrary future-schema compatibility claimed.
remainingAcceptance: serial actual native Trash and restoration of only owned complete App
final new Full/Slim source/fingerprint/native signatures and offline/install acceptance
serial real old/new DMG upgrade and selected snapshot rollback
final user/admin/offline deployment docs and complete applicable regression results
conclusion: Code review passed for current bounded implementation; final direct E2E/artifact/documentation acceptance remains pending.
